categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Xianglou New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of customized precision stamping new materials. Its products mainly include precision stamping materials for automotive parts, covering safety systems, seat systems, interior systems, and powertrain components. The company also focuses on high-end metal materials for bearings, robotics, and other industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced precision cold rolling and heat treatment technologies, mastering core techniques such as intergranular oxide and surface decarburization control. It uses flexible production processes tailored to customer-specific requirements, supported by automated equipment like AGC control systems and full hydrogen annealing furnaces. R&D efforts emphasize customized material design, process innovation, and integration with downstream product functions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international automotive parts suppliers, including Schaeffler, Mubea, Magna, Faurecia, Valeo, and others. The company indirectly supplies major automotive brands such as Tesla, BYD, NIO, BMW, Audi, and Mercedes-Benz. Besides automotive, emerging markets include high-end bearings, wind power, precision tools, electrical components, and robotics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou and Anhui. It serves domestic automotive manufacturing hubs concentrated in Northeast China, Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, South China, Central China, and Southwest China. It is also expanding its footprint to international markets through cooperation with global customers’ overseas production sites.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xianglou New Material operates upstream in the automotive supply chain as a supplier of advanced precision stamping metal materials to automotive parts manufacturers. It provides customized materials that are critical inputs for downstream component production and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-strength, high-plasticity precision stamping materials to support automotive lightweighting and new energy vehicles. It is expanding into high-end bearing materials, robotics key components, sensor materials, and hydrogen energy equipment. The newly established Xianglou Robotics Materials Research Institute focuses on innovative applications in robot core parts, aiming to break material bottlenecks and reduce costs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized precision stamping materials based on customer orders. The company provides R&D design services and develops differentiated production processes to meet specific client requirements, with pricing reflecting R&D cycles, production costs, and market demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xianglou New Material is the only listed company in China's precision stamping materials sector and ranks among the top domestic producers by capacity. While it has strong competitive advantages in technology, customer relationships, and quality control, it faces competition from foreign suppliers, especially in high-end materials where import substitution is ongoing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.485 billion, a 9.74% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 207 million, up 3.1%. Total assets reached RMB 1.976 billion, with steady growth in capacity and R&D investment. The company maintains high capacity utilization and is expanding production with new facilities expected to come online in 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xianglou New Material offers high-quality, stable, and customized precision stamping materials that enable downstream customers to reduce production costs and improve product quality. Its core technologies and flexible production processes allow it to meet stringent dimensional tolerances and mechanical performance requirements. The company emphasizes rapid customer response, strong technical support, and import substitution capabilities, particularly for high-end automotive and emerging robotics applications.
